description:
## Problem
`_reference_unavailable_reason` in benchbox/core/dataframe/query_validation.py accepts TPC-H SF 1 only without a seed (qgen default parameters). With `--seed`, every DataFrame row is SKIPPED and the run records `uncertain`, so it cannot be staged. The SQL path validates the same seeded SF 1 run through `QueryValidator`: fixed-cardinality queries are checked exactly and parameter-sensitive ones by loose or range rules (a seeded DuckDB SF 1 run on 2026-11-15 recorded 68 PASSED and 20 SKIPPED rows, summary passed). Since #4269 the DataFrame summary accepts documented skips, so routing seeded SF 1 through the same validator would give DataFrame the same evidence as SQL.

## Decision gate
Confirm with the owner that seeded DataFrame SF 1 bundles should be stageable. If the seed-corpus decision (seed-corpus-official-cells-refused-by-full-spec-20261115) drops seeded SF 1 cells, this item may be dropped instead.

## Change
Let a seeded TPC-H SF 1 DataFrame run use `_apply_expected_row_counts` with the reference-seed context set to False, as the SQL path does, instead of marking every row SKIPPED.

## Guardrails
- No change to SQL validation or to the submission validator.
- A skip without a documented reason must still keep the run uncertain.
- Unseeded SF 1 behaviour must not change.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if a seeded SF 1 DataFrame run gets the same per-query statuses as the seeded SQL run for the same queries (fixed counts checked, parameter-sensitive skips documented), a wrong fixed count fails the run, and unseeded SF 1 results are unchanged.
